name: Wavechaser Plain
desc: The site of the Pillar of Embla, a tower reaching towards the heavens. 500 years ago, the Professor intended to use the Sampo Mill to siphon the land's power and, through that tower, ascend to the "Elysium" he believed lay beyond the sky.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd780>January 10, 2026</color>
At the northern edge of Nod-Krai stands the foremost front line. The Wild Hunt is closing in. But the glow from the sacred pillar has awakened the very will of the land itself, and the grass and the trees are now soldiers, as all things rise in a mighty roar, ready to defend their homeland...
Let's feel the power of nature's fight against the Abyss together!

<color=#ffd780>January 11, 2026</color>
Today, let's turn our attention to the various factions that are present in the northern part of Nod-Krai. Here, you will find the Knights of Favonius, the Lightkeepers' headquarters, and even the Hexenzirkel...
And let's not forget the powerful local legends, who have chosen to reside here for various reasons...
Just what are they all after here? Let's find out!

<color=#ffd680>January 18, 2026</color>
It's been 5 days since the new area was made available. So, dear Traveler, how many secrets have you discovered here so far?
Where Reed Miller's treasure is hidden, the Royal Court of the Seelie, and the Abyss-plagued Kipumaki Cliff... There are adventures aplenty wherever you look, whether in the air, on the ground, or even underground!
Let's take a look at the mysterious World Quests that await in the new area!

customize.name: Winter Icelea
customize.desc: A hardy plant known for withstanding relentless wind and frost, it survives even in the coldest depths of winter.

customize.name: Pine Amber
customize.desc: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: Icy Pebble
customize.desc:
A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.
According to ancient legends, the hollows in these pebbles were once shelters revealed to the fae by the Frost Moon — gateways to the ethereal. In another story popular in Nasha Town, the legendary thief, Reed Miller, was surrounded when a runestone given to him by a holy lady of the Frost Moon as a token of her love allowed him to conceal himself and escape his pursuers. Naturally, the Frostmoon Scions vehemently reject this claim, as these pebbles do not display any such magical properties.

customize.name: Lakkaberry
customize.desc:
A fruit as white as pearl that tastes refreshingly sweet.
In the legends of the Frostmoon Scions, these fruits, like kuuhenki, are a gift from the Moon Maiden, a sacred symbol blessed by the new moon. Therefore, sharing and eating delicious Lakkaberries is also a form of worshipping Kuutar.
Even when not associated with the divine, their plumpness and sweetness alone are enough to awaken one's appetite.

customize.name: Midsommar Berry
customize.desc:
A fruit that grows in the warmer parts of Nod-Krai. It is beloved by animals emerging from winter and hungry children alike.
In the legacy of the Frostmoon Scions, Midsommar Berries are regarded as a symbol of life and abundance, for they only flourish during the warmth of spring and summer.
There is a tale that tells of the endless struggle between the King of Winter Holly and the King of Summer Oak — twin monarchs that slay each other as the seasons change, returning from the underworld to rule in turn until the end of time. Most Snezhnayan scholars dismiss this as a primitive religious metaphor for the alternating seasons — or at least that's what they tell themselves.

customize.name: Prismatic Severed Tail
customize.desc:
A crystallized tail vertebra left behind by a defeated Radiant Moongecko in its attempt to escape.
By all logic, a lizard that has evolved to such formidable strength should no longer face the threat of natural predators. Yet it still retains the instinct to shed its tail in a bid for survival. Perhaps in an age when moonlight blanketed the land, even more terrifying predators once prowled this place.

customize.name: Luna Treasure Compass
customize.desc:
A compass that can be used in Nod-Krai to search for nearby treasures and relevant clues.
This sublunary sphere holds countless unknown treasures, waiting to be discovered by adventurers with courage or wit.

customize.name: Irismoon Seal
customize.desc:
Collect all 3 seals to unlock the treasure vault on Wavechaser Plain.

You found this round, marked stone by chance while exploring. If you collect three with the same markings, you may be able to piece together a shadow of the bright moon that once illuminated the world.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 173
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Nod-Krai.

customize.name: Radiant Spincrystal 175
customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Nod-Krai.

customize.desc: This wondrous crystal contains a certain rhythm, like something beautiful woven from delicate silk. These items can be found throughout the mainland or from merchants who collect curios. The tune held within this crystal can be revivified in your Serenitea Pot using either "Euphonium Unbound: Winding" or "Euphonium Unbound: Soaring." The tune contained within this Radiant Spincrystal is a mysterious melody from Nod-Krai.

customize.name: Radiant Moongecko
customize.desc:
An ancient monster drawn to moonlight, this gecko dwells deep within layers of rock.
The gradual accumulation of kuuvahki has crystallized its body into segments as precise as mechanical components. These parts can harden and form stone spikes used to repel intruders.
Some scholars believe this unusual lizard's ancestors once roamed the surface. Over the ages, sweeping changes in the world drove them underground, where they have since lived in darkness for countless generations. Though their memory of true moonlight has faded, instinct remains. On nights of the full moon, they are compelled to gnaw on rock and soil suffused with lunar radiance to preserve their bloodline.

customize.name: Hiljetta
customize.desc: A legendary figure in the history of the Treasure Hoarders, Hiljetta was once feared and respected under the name "Black-Barrel Hag." Her exploits led to countless unforgettable tales and just as many grudges. Now living in seclusion somewhere in Nod-Krai, she spends her days lost in memories of her former glory. Her final wish is to find a worthy successor, someone who can carry forward the great dream she never managed to realize.

customize.name: "The Homesick Lone Wolf"
customize.desc: A lone wolf estranged from the local pack, with its teal mane indicating a bloodline from a faraway land. Perhaps it is the echo of its ancestors that still lingers in its veins, for it remains steadfast in guarding a sword cemetery long forgotten by the world. In the moonlight, it waits endlessly for a knight who will never find their way home.

customize.name: Surging Currents: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form.
Its clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Veiled Cloudchaser: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Anemo, resulting in its present form.
The flowing wind has spun an extra pair of wings for it. As it almost never leaves footprints on the ground, it's also known as the one who walks with the wind.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Gilded Sunshard: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Geo, resulting in its present form.
Just about its entire body is covered by the accumulated Geo, while its tough antlers gleam with the luster of polished amber.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Radiant Glacial Wolf
customize.desc:
A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.
Legend has it that when a dark calamity wiped out countless lives, the frontier forests fell completely silent. In that stillness, the only sound to break the dead quiet was the howl of the Glacial Wolves calling to the moon. Night after night, their mournful cries echoed across the empty wilderness in the cold moonlight.

customize.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

customize.name: Oprichniki Thunderblitz Gvardiya
customize.desc:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in using twin guns in combat.
Unlike their Skirmisher cousins, Oprichniki officers almost all hail from the Snezhnaya Royal Military Academy, whether due to the privilege of noble birth or the rare talent to escape a common background. After all, neither is truly different from the other within the Tsaritsa's beneficent, loving ideals. Traditionally, only fae could become elite Gvardiya, but today, this glorious role and title has been given to Oprichniki officers — a more equal division for the construction of a new world.

customize.name: Oprichniki Line Trooper
customize.desc:
A soldier of the Fatui Oprichniki, equipped with a gunblade and tasked to hold the line as the resilient backbone of the Oprichniki forces.
According to Snezhnayan infantry manuals, the primary duties of line troops are merely to aim, shoot, and charge. Even should the individual soldier's combat power not prove exceptional, soldiers of the line in tight formation remain a key foundation of the Snezhnayan military machine.

customize.name: Pedunculate Oak Wood
customize.desc: Wood sourced from the Pedunculate Oak Tree. While its density is relatively low, it boasts impressive toughness and water resistance, making it a common choice for buildings near bodies of water.

customize.name: Silver Fir Wood
customize.desc: Wood harvested from the Silver Fir Tree. Humans have favored this type of wood since ancient times for its wide range of uses, from crafting barrels to constructing frameworks.

customize.name: Alder Wood
customize.desc: Wood from the Alder Tree. It demonstrates considerable resistance to moisture and cold, making it a fine raw material for both furniture and musical instruments.

customize.name: Alia
customize.desc: The second Reed Miller and the First Moonchanter's sister from the Frostmoon Scions. She lived 500 years ago.

customize.name: Rotwang
customize.desc: A "mad monk,' exiled from Khaenri'ah, who dreamt of the pitch-black Elysium. His real name is Rauthvangi.

customize.name: Reed Miller
customize.desc: Avrelian was the ideal heir who was supposed to lead the Frosmoon Scions to the Elysium. He was the Great Thief, Reed Miller, and the founder of the Treasure Hoarders. Avrelian lived 500 years ago.

customize.name: The Things That Coexist With Kuuvahki...

imgDesc.text: Perhaps the idea of an imperfect world is even harder to swallow than that of the apocalypse.
This place is inhabited only by the grotesque ghostly remains of fallen gods, where the former palaces of the Seelie now stand empty.

The tower once stood as the hubris of ambition, bearing the illusory dreams of the bedeviled skies. It was only when the tower shattered — along with the swelling ambition it represented — that the seed of "Elysium" finally broke through the earth.
